conditions.condition_text: Draw a box using the high and low of the previous day and extend it one day into the future.
The daily candle defines the range and provides liquidity targets.
Wait for a confirmed breakout by waiting for a full 15-minute candle close above the daily high or below the daily low.
A full candle close confirms the breakout from the daily range.
Wait for a reversal candle (Hammer, Inverted Hammer, or Engulfing) to appear at the breakout level.
The reversal candle signals potential market exhaustion and a bounce.
The trade must be taken within the first two and a half hours of the market open.
A confirmed 15-minute candle close must occur outside the previous day's high or low.
A reversal candle (Hammer, Inverted Hammer, or Engulfing) must appear at the breakout level.
The stop is placed at the low of the reversal candle for long entries, or slightly above the high for short entries.
The speaker suggests setting the target profit to three times the stop loss.
